queries.name: Movies by two actors together
queries.sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date AS release_date
FROM movies m1
JOIN casts c1 ON m1.id = c1.movie_id
JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id
JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id
WHERE p1.name = :actor1_name AND j1.name = 'Actor'
INTERSECT
SELECT m2.name AS movie_name, m2.date AS release_date
FROM movies m2
JOIN casts c2 ON m2.id = c2.movie_id
JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id
JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id
WHERE p2.name = :actor2_name AND j2.name = 'Actor'
ORDER BY release_date DESC NULLS LAST;

queries.name: Top successful movies in a year(in millions of USD)
queries.sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, (m.revenue / 1000000) AS total_revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = :year
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit_val;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, (m.revenue / 1000000) AS total_revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = 2024
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

queries.name: Top successful movies of all time in a particular genre(with revenue in millions of USD)
queries.sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
JOIN movie_categories mc ON m.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN categories c ON mc.category_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = :genre_name
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
JOIN movie_categories mc ON m.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN categories c ON mc.category_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = :genre_name
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit;

queries.name: Top movies of a movie series
queries.sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m1.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m1
JOIN movies m2 ON m1.parent_id = m2.id
WHERE m2.name = :movie_name AND m1.kind = :kind
ORDER BY m1.revenue DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m1.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m1
JOIN movies m2 ON m1.parent_id = m2.id
WHERE m2.name = 'James Bond - 007' AND m1.kind = 'movie'
ORDER BY m1.revenue DESC NULLS LAST;
